headline: Nordea shares fall more than 7 per cent after the bank pauses its buyback
deck: Quarterly results were roughly as forecast; the bank is waiting for the European Central Bank to settle how it measures risk, which is not expected until 2027.
standard: Shares in Nordea, the Nordic region's largest bank, were down 7.3 per cent at 12:50 on Thursday, the worst in C25, Denmark's leading share index, after the bank paused a share buyback that investors had expected. Third-quarter profit fell to 1,181 million euros; that and revenue of 2,968 million euros were roughly what analysts had forecast.
Nordea is waiting for the European Central Bank to settle how it should measure its risks, an answer not expected until 2027. Børsen says the buyback would have been worth about 500 million euros.
Berlingske puts the cost to shareholders at 28.2 billion kroner. Other banks' shares also fell, but by less.
short: Shares in Nordea, the Nordic region's largest bank, were down 7.3 per cent at 12:50 on Thursday after it paused an expected share buyback. It is waiting for the European Central Bank to settle how it should measure its risks, an answer not expected until 2027.
